branch.production_path: PF8 Legacy sigma-base and uint8 final-store path

evidence_boundary: Executes the actual Windows AEX PF8 Legacy worker with a complete native uint8 A,R,G,B buffer and bounded host-suite shims, then replays that buffer through the Mac production PF8 Legacy worker. The byte pattern is independently constructed around 0/1/127/128/254/255 and is not a quantized PF16 or PF32 fixture. It does not execute AE parameter checkout/materialization or claim AE-host exactness.
remaining_gaps: AE-host parameter materialization for non-default Smoothness remains unproven.
Post-restart loading and rendering with the installed Universal bundle remain pending.
NonLegacy recovered workers accept but do not consume Smoothness; public entrypoint plumbing remains a separate question.
